dockerfile:
# loong64 self-built (wave3) - gitea CE substitute for commitgo/gitea-ee
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata git su-exec 2>/dev/null || (sed -i 's|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g' /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata git su-exec)
WORKDIR /app
COPY gitea /app/gitea
COPY public/assets /app/public/assets
COPY entrypoint.sh /app/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/gitea /app/entrypoint.sh && addgroup -g 1000 git && adduser -D -u 1000 -G git git && mkdir -p /app/data /app/custom /data && chown -R git:git /app /data
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai GITEA_WORK_DIR=/app USER_UID=1000 USER_GID=1000
EXPOSE 3000
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]

files.entrypoint.sh:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
  for d in /app/data /app/custom /data; do [ -d "$d" ] && chown -R "${USER_UID:-1000}:${USER_GID:-1000}" "$d"; done
  exec su-exec "${USER_UID:-1000}:${USER_GID:-1000}" /app/gitea
fi
exec /app/gitea

dockerfile:
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN sed -i "s|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g" /etc/apk/repositories 2>/dev/null; true
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata
COPY komari /usr/local/bin/komari
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/komari
EXPOSE 25774
CMD ["/usr/local/bin/komari", "server", "-c", "/config/config.yml"]

files.config.yaml:
storage: /verdaccio/storage/data
auth:
  htpasswd:
    file: /verdaccio/storage/htpasswd
    max_users: -1
uplinks:
  npmjs:
    url: https://registry.npmmirror.com
packages:
  '@*/*':
    access: $all
    publish: $authenticated
    unpublish: $authenticated
  '**':
    access: $all
    publish: $authenticated
    unpublish: $authenticated
middlewares:
  audit:
    enabled: true
log: { type: stdout, format: pretty, level: http }
web: { title: Verdaccio }
publish: true

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com TZ=Asia/Shanghai
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN npm install -g verdaccio@7.1.0
RUN mkdir -p /verdaccio/storage && chmod -R 777 /verdaccio
COPY config.yaml /verdaccio/config.yaml
VOLUME /verdaccio/storage
EXPOSE 4873
ENTRYPOINT ["verdaccio","--config","/verdaccio/config.yaml","--listen","0.0.0.0:4873"]
